kjv: the third part of trees was burnt up
mine: a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees
note: TR omits "kai to triton tes ges katekae" (and a third of the earth was burned up; Sinaiticus, A, P), by homoeoteleuton.

kjv: I heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven
mine: I heard an eagle crying … as it flew directly overhead
note: TR "angelou" against "aetou" (eagle; Sinaiticus, A); the angel replaces John's eagle, perhaps under influence of 14:6.
